newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Petroleum has Belize dry hole.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Petroleum has Belize dry hole.

text.p: Magellan Petroleum Corp said Wednesday the Gladden No. 1 wildcat well offshore Belize is expected to be plugged and abandoned after finding no commercial hydrocarbons.

The well reached its planned depth of 8,000 feet with no indications of commercially recoverable hydrocarbons, the company said. The drilling data will be studied to assess possible additional activity on the permit, it added.

The company said its 51 percent owned subsidiary Magellan Petroleum Australia Ltd has a 20 percent working interest in the well, with an additional 2.5 percent held directly by the U.S. parent. Other major interests are held by Germany's Deminex, Petrofina SA and Dover Technology Inc, the operator for the group.
Deminex is a German exploration and company owned by Veba AG/Veba Oel AG, RWE-DEA AG and BASF AG.
